gen-gf-bellota-gf-moderustic: Stylus-drawn and wild: Bellota lets its s ends hang far from the spine. Moderustic, the sans-serif below, traces its curves with a broad nib and leaves them unfinished, so everything feels loose and contemporary.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-momo-trust-sans: Hand-traced swagger: Bellota draws each stroke at the width of one stylus and lets its s ends hang. But where Bellota makes the statement, Momo Trust Sans does the friendly talking, curves left wide and unclosed.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-canadian-abo: Distinctive in every join, Bellota never thins a connection below the weight of its stems. And Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal feels contemporary and unguarded beside it, every curve end left open.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoan: Bellota is distinctive, with strokes that never mix bold-looking and light-looking inside a single word. Noto Sans Cypro Minoan cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap, a professional look set against Bellota.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-inscriptiona: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi keeps every small counter unclogged. Bellota above it has a pipe-cleaner look to every stroke, which makes the approachable, contemporary body below feel all the more open.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Letters sketched with a pencil that never presses harder give Bellota its look, with s ends that hang far from the spine. Noto Sans Linear A counters with a visibly gaping c at any size.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Noto Sans Linear B is smooth, modern and unobstructed around each bend. Beneath Bellota, whose r, n and m have arches matching their stems, paragraphs would glide along without a snag.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-lue: Distinctive monoline strokes run through every line of a Bellota heading. Under them, Noto Sans New Tai Lue rounds its letters so they look cupped, not clenched, and paragraphs would feel modern.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-palanquin: Cut like an engraver's blade, Bellota hangs its s ends far from the spine and never deepens a stroke. Palanquin, the sans-serif, brings contemporary curves with wide, unclosed mouths.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-philosopher: Bellota draws everything with a blueprint-lettering feel of constant line. Philosopher sits below with curves full of daylight and soft shifts in thickness, its horizontals a notch lighter than the uprights.
